description: A splat over an unknown list of objects gives an unknown list of the attribute type
notes: The spec doesn't give the result type of a splat over a list, and it calls a splat approximately equivalent to a for expression, which over an unknown collection gives the dynamic value. hashicorp/hcl gives a list for a list source, and for an unknown list an unknown list of the attribute's type (SplatExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go).
